title: docs(spec,i18n): stop naming the removed feature_flags settings namespace
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuV5cRafodM2YQHxeDkdiWJM)_

domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVugtCCwBs98FeR27P
Fixes #30282
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:设置中心副标题在十种语言里不再提“功能开关”;spec 的三处注释不再指向已删除的 `feature_flags` 设置命名空间。
- 为什么改:该命名空间与其设置页已随 PR #30272 删除,管理员按副标题找不到页面,开发者按注释设 `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` 也不生效。
- 风险与回滚:只改文案与注释,无代码、无 key 增删;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`(副标题)、`packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts`(注释新说法)、`ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts`(新守卫)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui/packages/i18n && pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts`,预期 21 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Spec doc comments (`@objectstack/spec`, comments only, no schema/type/export change)** — written from the live code: `builtinSettingsManifests` in `@objectstack/service-settings` carries no `feature_flags` manifest, and `envKeyOf` spells the env override `OS_` + upper-cased `namespace_key`.

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts` (feature.zod removal note) FROM "Live toggles are the `feature_flags` settings manifest (ADR-0007, env-overridable via OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*) and the PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES registry (public-auth-features.ts) for auth gates." TO "There is no central feature-flag namespace: a setting a plugin reads is declared on that plugin's own settings manifest (SettingsManifestSchema, ADR-0007, env-overridable via OS_{NAMESPACE}_{KEY}), and the capabilities a deployment advertises to clients are the PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES registry (public-auth-features.ts)."
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` (module docblock) FROM "NOT to be confused with runtime rollout toggles — those live on the `feature_flags` settings manifest (ADR-0007), not in the spec (the former …" TO "NOT to be confused with a runtime setting — that is declared on the settings manifest of the plugin that reads it (ADR-0007), not in this registry; there is no central feature-flag namespace (the former …" (rest of the sentence unchanged).
- `packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` (module docblock) FROM "(e.g. `mail`, `branding`, `feature_flags`)" TO "(e.g. `mail`, `branding`, `localization`)" — all three are registered namespaces.
- `content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx` regenerated by `gen:docs` (the only artifact `check:generated` proved stale): frontmatter `description` and body line follow the docblock.

**`console.settingsHub.subtitle` (`@object-ui/i18n`), all ten packs; no key added or removed:**

| Pack | FROM | TO |
|:---|:---|:---|
| en | Configure your system, integrations, and feature flags. | Configure your system and integrations. |
| de | Konfigurieren Sie Ihr System, Integrationen und Feature-Flags. | Konfigurieren Sie Ihr System und Ihre Integrationen. |
| es | Configure su sistema, las integraciones y los indicadores de funciones. | Configure su sistema y sus integraciones. |
| fr | Configurez votre système, vos intégrations et vos indicateurs de fonctionnalité. | Configurez votre système et vos intégrations. |
| pt | Configure seu sistema, integrações e sinalizadores de recursos. | Configure seu sistema e suas integrações. |
| ru | Настройте систему, интеграции и флаги функций. | Настройте систему и интеграции. |
| ja | システム、連携、機能フラグを設定します。 | システムと連携を設定します。 |
| ko | 시스템, 연동, 기능 플래그를 구성합니다. | 시스템과 연동을 구성합니다. |
| zh | 配置系统、集成与功能开关。 | 配置系统与集成。 |
| ar | اضبط النظام والتكاملات وأعلام الميزات. | اضبط النظام والتكاملات. |

**Pin** — a new top-level `describe` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-copy-system-noun-12956.test.ts` (the existing console-copy pin that already enumerates `console.settingsHub`): every pack in `builtInLocales` (floor 10) has a string subtitle matching none of the ten languages' feature-flag terms, plus a matcher self-check that each term catches the retired wording. The spec docblocks are comments: no pin owed.

**Changeset** — `.changeset/30282-feature-flags-namespace-text.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@object-ui/i18n` (published, not private), with both declaration lines.

## Verification

All readings at head `f1e4de5bd2`, worktree `objectstack-issue-30282`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` → exit 0; `check:generated` → first run named `content/docs/references/**` stale (plus a `check:test-typecheck` "failed without diagnostics" that ran without a heap flag; re-run alone with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` → OK, ledger held); `gen:docs` → exit 0; re-run `check:generated` → exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test` → exit 0, Test Files 95 passed, Tests 1460 passed / 13 skipped (`all-locales-key-parity` included).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` → exit 0 (after building the `@object-ui/i18n^...` closure).
- `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` → exit 0: 1 `en` value changed, 9 pack values followed.
- Ablation (pin): `de` subtitle restored to the old wording through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `fb80a411` → `b9c43ae3`) → the pin went red, 1 failed / 20 passed, `de subtitle names no feature flags` (matched `/feature[\s-]?flags?/iu`); restore: blob after = HEAD blob `fb80a411`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 104 families, each run with its exit code recorded; `--ran` → "104 derived, 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" after the prerequisite re-runs below.
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring` → exit 0. eslint on the three spec files (`--no-inline-config`) → exit 0; eslint (ui config) on the test and the ten packs → exit 0.

<details><summary>Gate families (104) — exit codes</summary>

- 103 families exit 0 on their final run. Six first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/client-react`, `@objectstack/objectql`, full package build) and were re-run after building those closures: `check:doc-formula-expressions` 0, `check:doc-security-posture` 0, spec `check:skill-examples` 0, `check:docs-transcript-drift` 0, `check:lean-entry-closure` 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` → exit 1 in this worktree: 2 failures, both in `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` (the forked `FormulaFunctions.dateOnlyZone-10866` control case answers `11:00` for `03:00`). Not this diff: the diff touches neither `packages/formula` nor `ui/packages/core`, and a control worktree at base `aad1603cc2` with only `@objectstack/formula` built passes the same file 29/29, both without and with this branch's patch applied. The red follows this worktree's extra built `ui/` dists, not the source change. CI's run of this family is the verdict.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1: the docblocks now name the live answer (the reading plugin's own settings manifest; `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` for deployment-advertised capabilities). Acceptance 2: the subtitle drops feature flags in all ten packs. Acceptance 3: PR #30272 merged 2026-11-05T05:47Z.
- Every site was measured at `origin/main` `aad1603c` and was where the card said; none had moved or been fixed.
- Open PR #30595 (renames `zh.ts` / `pt.ts`, adds a generated `zh-Hant.ts`) had not merged at push time, so the subtitle is edited in today's file shapes; whichever lands second carries the new subtitle onto the other's shape. The pin enumerates `builtInLocales`, so a `zh-Hant` pack that copies the old Chinese wording is caught.
- Left as is, outside this card: `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.test.ts` and `packages/spec/src/system/settings-banner-translation.test.ts` use `feature_flags` only as an arbitrary identifier in test fixtures; `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` entries naming `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` are release-owned history; `skills/**` is #30275's.
